name: amzn-selling-partner-codegen
description: oagen-based generator for the amzn_selling_partner Python package

scripts.regenerate: npm run spec:build && npm run sdk:generate -- --spec .build/openapi.yml --namespace Client && npm run spec:build -- --petstore && oagen generate --lang python --spec .build/petstore.yml --namespace Client --output ../tests/petstore_sdk && npm run format
